If I am right, the language involves an untranslatable word-play between @i{allallu}, a type of bird which also appears in l. 48 as a former object of Ištar’s desires, and the noun which is a synonym of ‘warrior’ (@i{Malku} I 27: @akk{al-lal-lu} = @akk{qar-ra-du}).
